    m' Del ∗ □ ∀ k, Del k -∗ Del' k) ⊢ mvcc.snapThin m m' Del'

theorem mvcc.isKeyBackendG_weaken_noDel (b : GoInterface) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT
    WT NC : IProp GF) (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del Del' :
    GoString → IProp GF) (W Wi Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp Cmp' : Prop) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp
    GF) (Req : IProp GF → IProp GF → IProp GF) (Rb : GMap GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF) (Bt :
    GoInterfaceOk → IProp GF) (SR SRh MW SR' SRh' MW' HN : IProp GF) (hC : ¬Cmp') :
    (mvcc.isKeyBackendG b View RT WT NC PutOk Del W Wi Dep Cmp P HF Req Rb Bt SR SRh MW HN ∗ □ ∀ k,
    Del k -∗ False) ⊢ mvcc.isKeyBackendG b View RT WT NC PutOk Del' W Wi Dep Cmp' P HF Req Rb Bt SR'
    SRh' MW' HN

    IProp GF) (PutOk : mvcc.Bucket → mvcc.Puts → GoString → GoString → Prop) (Del Del' : GoString →
    IProp GF) (W Wi Dep : IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (P : IProp GF) (HF : val → IProp GF) (Rb : GMap
    GoString backend.BktData → IProp GF) (Bt : GoInterfaceOk → IProp GF) (MW HN : IProp GF) :
    mvcc.isBatchTxG bt View RT WT PutOk Del W Wi Dep Cmp P HF Rb Bt MW HN ∗ (□ ∀ k, Del k -∗ ◇ Del'
    k) ∗ □ (⌜Cmp⌝ -∗ ∀ k, Del' k -∗ Del k) ⊢ mvcc.isBatchTxG bt View RT WT PutOk Del' W Wi Dep Cmp P
    HF Rb Bt MW HN
